basic_profile.bio: Avid Destiny 2 player based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. I've been a gamer since the days of the original Xbox and have a particular love for FPS and RPG games. I'm a night owl, often found online between 10 PM and 2 AM after my day job as a graphic designer. I'm passionate about music (huge fan of The Killers), and I enjoy exploring quirky interests like frog habitats. Currently single, I spend my weekends gaming or exploring local music gigs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of video games, particularly Destiny 2, which I have been playing for over a year. I keep up with game updates, patches, and community strategies through various forums and Twitch streams. My graphic design skills are largely self-taught, honed through online tutorials and practice.
